# Visit Clear Creek County

> > Official tourism guide for Clear Creek County, Colorado, featuring Victorian mountain towns, gold rush history, skiing, and outdoor recreation along the I-70 corridor near Denver.

Visit Clear Creek County promotes tourism in the historic mining region west of Denver, encompassing Georgetown, Idaho Springs, Silver Plume, Empire, and other mountain communities. The county offers year-round outdoor activities, historic mine tours, narrow gauge railroad experiences, and access to ski resorts along Interstate 70 in the Rocky Mountains.

## Key Topics

- Clear Creek County
- Idaho Springs
- Georgetown
- Gold rush history
- Mine tours
- Victorian mountain towns
- Colorado skiing
- Mountain recreation

- Outdoor activities
- Responsible tourism
- Silver Plume
- Denver day trips

## Towns & Destinations

- [Visit Georgetown](https://visitclearcreek.com/visit-georgetown-colorado): Georgetown Victorian town with hiking, mine tours, and train rides
- [Idaho Springs, Colorado](https://visitclearcreek.com/towns/idaho-springs-colorado): Idaho Springs Victorian town with Mount Blue Sky Byway and gold mines

## Mining Heritage & History

- [Capital Prize Mine | Mining Madness](https://visitclearcreek.com/mining-madness-capital-prize): Capital Prize Gold Mine 1860s underground tour in Georgetown
- [The Phoenix Gold Mine | Old West History](https://visitclearcreek.com/mining-madness-phoenix-gold-mine): Phoenix Gold Mine tours in Idaho Springs Trail Creek Mining District
- [Beauty, History + Adventure](https://visitclearcreek.com/beauty-history-adventure-and-more): Gold rush history and historical sites in Idaho Springs and Georgetown
- [Ride the Narrow Gauge Railroad](https://visitclearcreek.com/the-narrow-gauge-railroad): Historic narrow gauge railroad and steam locomotive tours
- [Haunted Clear Creek](https://visitclearcreek.com/haunted-clear-creek): Ghost tours at Hotel de Paris Museum and haunted mine attractions

## Winter Activities & Skiing

- [Colorado Skiing | Echo Mountain & Loveland](https://visitclearcreek.com/colorado-skiing-in-clear-creek): Echo Mountain & Loveland ski resorts near Denver in Clear Creek County
- [Ice Fishing](https://visitclearcreek.com/ice-fishing): Ice fishing at Georgetown Lake for trout in Clear Creek County

## Recreation & Wellness

- [Recreation + Fitness Centers](https://visitclearcreek.com/activities/recreation-fitness-centers): Clear Creek County rec centers with fitness classes and family activities
- [Spas + Salons](https://visitclearcreek.com/activities/spas): Mountain spas, massage therapy, and salons in Clear Creek County

## Seasonal Experiences

- [Fall in Love With Clear Creek County](https://visitclearcreek.com/fall-in-clear-creek-county): Fall foliage, autumn activities, and Victorian town day trips

## Visitor Information

- [LiveWild](https://visitclearcreek.com/livewild): Responsible tourism guidelines with Leave No Trace principles
- [Visitor Centers | Travel Information](https://visitclearcreek.com/clear-creek-county-visitor-centers): Georgetown and Idaho Springs visitor centers with maps and info
- [Travel Facts | Visitor Information](https://visitclearcreek.com/clear-creek-county-travel-facts): Travel facts, statistics, and elevation data for Clear Creek County
- [Floyd Hill](https://visitclearcreek.com/floyd-hill): I-70 Floyd Hill construction alerts and traffic updates from CDOT
